checks.name: Production realm, HTTPS required, self-registration closed
Realm contains no users, credentials, client secrets or SMTP secrets
Public authorization-code client, no password/implicit/service grants
S256 is mandatory
Redirects are exactly the portal origin and root path
Web origin is exact and logout redirects to the exact origin
Only the reviewed public origin environment placeholder is imported
Access tokens have API audience and human identity claim
Partner and channel claims are admin managed; unmanaged attributes disabled
Refresh rotation, email verification and brute-force protection enabled
Optimized build includes PostgreSQL and health/metrics at build time
Reviewed official image digest is mandatory; no mutable default
No secret build arguments/defaults and final UID is non-root
Production command includes import; development commands cannot start
Management health is on 9000 and JDBC discovery is enabled
Runtime accepts a dedicated HTTPS origin or the exact portal /auth URL with trusted proxies and DB TLS
Public CA bundle is checked by reviewed hash and certificate constraints before build
PowerShell build and validation scripts parse without errors
entrypoint.sh has LF endings and a Bash shebang
validate-runtime.sh has LF endings and a Bash shebang
healthcheck.sh has LF endings and a Bash shebang

limitations: Static contracts do not prove a successful container build, Keycloak import, TLS connection, JDBC_PING cluster or running service.
A real reviewed official-image digest and public RDS CA bundle/hash are required before build.
No image download, Docker build, ECR push or AWS mutation was executed by this validator.
